# Drone News 48h Brief — September 25, 2026

_Window: last 48 hours; 120 incidents._

## Summary
In the past 48 hours, drone incidents have occurred across various categories, highlighting security threats and law enforcement actions. Notably, Russia launched drone strikes in Ukraine, resulting in casualties, while Pakistan conducted airstrikes targeting suspected drone launch sites in Afghanistan, claiming civilian casualties. There has also been an uptick in contraband-related incidents, particularly involving drones supplying drugs and other illicit items to prisons in Georgia and Johnson State Prison. Additionally, there are reports of unauthorized drone flights disrupting air traffic in Berlin and Romania. The international landscape shows increasing concerns around drone warfare, particularly with rising military actions involving drones in conflict zones like Ukraine and Pakistan.
